structures: "Being Single Is Now An Unaffordable Luxury": Holiday hook and premise → Couples share expenses → Marriage earnings premium (NLSY) → Married women earn less → Dating costs lock out singles

"Has LinkedIn Ruined Your Career?": Strange platform, ruined career? → LinkedIn vs Twitter acquisition value → Way 1: marketplace that hands hiring power to employers → Way 2: information imbalance → Way 3: forced self-comparison → Way 4: corporate worship

"Most People Alive Today Will Work Until They Die": Retirement savings crisis → Reason 1: cost of living and debt → Reason 2: nobody wants to think about it → Reason 3: investors mess it up → What realistic returns do to the math

"The 40 Year Career Is Dead... And That's a Good Thing": The old career model is ending → Workers are less ambitious → Remote work and bullshit jobs → Reason 1: no financial payoff for promotion → Reason 2: entrepreneurial ambitions → Reason 3: promotions slow your pay → Reason 4: they just do not want them → Problems for companies

"The Real Reason Companies Have Become Obsessed With Your Data": Data as a trillion-dollar account → Big data as an asset → Cheap storage and the data bet → Data moats → Cheaper to analyze: off-the-shelf tools → Hedge funds buying card data

"What You Need To Know About SVB, Silvergate & Signature Bank Collapses": Second-largest bank collapse → Silvergate: the crypto bank → Bitcoin crash and Silvergate liquidation → SVB: the startup bank → Rising rates and the bond losses → Bank run and government backstop

"Why Corporate America Is Obsessed With "Company Culture"": Culture obsession and its cost → Reason 1: a company cult → Reason 2: workplace pushback and PR → Reason 3: everyone else is doing it → How culture hurts careers

"Why Do Tech Companies Hire and Fire So Much?": Tech layoff wave → Hire reason 1: diversification and growth → Fire reason 1: because they can → Hire reason 2: monopoly and non-competes → Fire reason 2: no startup threat → Fire reason 3 and hire reason 3: cheap talent, bad management
